who.title: Who is this appointment for?
who.lead: We'll write your summary from the right point of view.

concern.title: What would you like to talk to your doctor about?
concern.lead: Write it in your own words, in any language. There's no wrong way to say it.

timing.title: How long and how often?
timing.lead: Pick the answers that fit best. “I'm not sure” is fine.

changes.title: Have you noticed any changes or patterns?
changes.lead: For example, if it's worse at night, after food, or at certain times.

medicines.title: Medicines and help so far
medicines.lead: This step is optional. You can skip it.

worries.title: Is anything worrying you, or making this hard to talk about?
worries.lead: This step is optional. You can skip it.

who.labelHint: For example: my mum, my neighbour.

timing.notesLabel: Anything else about when it happens? (optional)
